{{Quote|I live to serve.''"<br />"''You're dead and still serving. The Emdee-fours should have let you die.|Colonel "Antar Roat" and a customs official on Coruscant|<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
The '''MD-4''' was a model of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] and a part of the [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series]] that was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. It was slightly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in appearance.

This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model had specialized appendages for performing microsurgical procedures and could perform these without assistance.

==Description==
[[File:MD-4_microsurgery.jpg|thumb|left|The MD-4's microsurgery appendage]]
[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] MD-4<ref name="SWS" /> [[Class one droid/Legends|class one droid]]<ref name="Arms" /> was part of the [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series]] of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]].<ref name="SWS" /> Related to the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]]&mdash;another of Industrial Automaton's products<ref name="Droids" />&mdash;in terms of aesthetic design, it was 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]] tall and had a torso unit with two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] topped by a cranial unit.<ref name="FF" /> The legs<ref name="Arms" /> were shrouded in a surgical gown to protect delicate internal mechanisms.<ref name="Droids" /> MD-4 droids were ambidextrous.<ref name="Arms" />

MD-series droids generally had [[Color/Legends|gray]] plating and green highlights. The [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] were yellow.<ref name="FF" /> Costing 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], MD-4s were available for purchase throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Arms" /> The torso was the location of a connection socket to allow the droid to directly connect to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="Droids" /> The MD-4 employed [[reduction servomotor]]s and [[Reduction actuator|actuators]] to give their arms slow, precise movements to perform complex surgical procedures.<ref name="SWS" />

==Role==
MD-4 droids were intended for surgical purposes, with specialized microsurgical appendages, including miniaturized [[vibroscapel]]s, [[Flexclamp/Legends|flex clamps]], and fiber optics.<ref name="SWS" />

==History==
Constructed on the [[droid factory]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Telti/Legends|Telti]],<ref name="Droids" /> they were employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Aboard the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', an MD-4 droid oversaw the surgical unit.<ref name="FO">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> Three MD-4 droids served under [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Momaw Mowadan]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].<ref name="RM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> Antar Roat, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' cover identity to infiltrate [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], was said to have been treated for battle injuries by MD-4s.<ref name="WG" />
